note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable code). It defines model settings for RetinaNet with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck. No callable APIs exist for direct CLI usage.
summarize_model_config: summarize the RetinaNet ResNet50 FPN model configuration dictionary and its hyperparameters
review_train_cfg: review the MaxIoUAssigner training configuration with pos_iou_thr 0.5 and PseudoSampler settings
review_test_cfg: review the test configuration with nms_pre 1000 score threshold 0.05 and max 100 detections per image
review_backbone_config: review the ResNet depth 50 backbone configuration with pretrained torchvision weights and frozen stages
review_bbox_head: review the RetinaHead configuration with FocalLoss gamma 2.0 alpha 0.25 and L1Loss for bounding box regression
